item.guhs.guhwinter_surprise.niks: Empty wrapping. Nothing in here (yet), nyeg.
item.guhs.guhwinter_surprise.leeg: Oops... this present is empty. But it was wrapped with lots and lots of love!
item.guhs.guhwinter_surprise.lore: Hold it to see where it goes. Right-click puts it down; R or shift+scroll turns it. Shift+right-click your surprise to pick it up again.
item.guhs.guhwinter_zak.lore: Right-click to open it. Whatever doesn't fit in your bag stays safely inside.
guhwinter.lootjes.boek.sint: The Sint: "Who wants to join the drawing of names? Write your name in my book, dear guh!"
guhwinter.lootjes.boek.jij_erin: Your name is in it! Wahoog!
guhwinter.lootjes.boek.vol: The Big Book is full! All eight places are taken.
guhwinter.lootjes.boek.knop.uit.hover: Take your name out of the book again
guhwinter.lootjes.boek.wanneer: You can sign up through 30 November 23:59. On 1 December the Sint draws the names, then you build and draw until 5 December 18:00. Pakjesavond: 5 December 19:00!
guhwinter.lootjes.boek.trekken_straks: The book is closed. At midnight the Sint draws the names... exciting, nyeg!
guhwinter.lootjes.boek.dicht: The book is closed for this year. Next year you'll surely join!
guhwinter.lootjes.boek.mislukt: There weren't enough names in the book to draw. The Sint sent everyone a little letter.
guhwinter.lootjes.boek.niet_mee: The Sint has drawn the names! You didn't join this year, but do have a look at the plots in Surprise Lane.
guhwinter.lootjes.boek.jouw_lootje: Shh... you drew %s! Your build plot is number %s in Surprise Lane.
guhwinter.lootjes.boek.knop.teken.hover: A drawing for the name you drew (64 by 64)
guhwinter.lootjes.boek.tot: You can build and draw until 5 December 18:00. Whatever is there by then goes to your name!
guhwinter.lootjes.boek.wachten: Everything is wrapped! Just a little wait for pakjesavond, 5 December 19:00...
guhwinter.lootjes.boek.klaar: All the surprises have been handed out. What a party! Wahoog!
guhwinter.lootjes.in.dicht: The Big Book is closed now: you can't sign up any more.
guhwinter.lootjes.in.al: Your name is already in the book, silly guh!
guhwinter.lootjes.in.gelukt: Your name is in the Big Book! (%s of %s) On 1 December you'll get a letter from the Sint.
guhwinter.lootjes.uit.te_laat: You can't sign out any more: the names are (almost) drawn.
guhwinter.lootjes.uit.niet: Your name wasn't in the book.
guhwinter.lootjes.uit.gelukt: Your name is out of the book again. Aww! You can sign up again through 30 November.
guhwinter.lootjes.teken.geen_lootje: You didn't draw a name, so there's nothing to draw.
guhwinter.lootjes.teken.dicht: Too late! After 5 December 18:00 everything is wrapped.
guhwinter.lootjes.teken.bewaard: Your drawing for %s is saved! You can still change it until 5 December 18:00.
guhwinter.lootjes.teken.bijgewerkt: Your drawing for %s is updated. Nyeg, even prettier!
guhwinter.lootjes.bouwen.in: Welcome to your build plot! Make something lovely for %s. Your things are safe with the Sint until you walk out again.
guhwinter.lootjes.bouwen.regels: Anything pretty goes (diamond too!). No chests, machines, redstone or spawners. You can only build and fly inside your own plot.
guhwinter.lootjes.bouwen.uit: You walked out of your build plot: your own things are back!
guhwinter.lootjes.bouwen.tijd_om: Building is over: your own things are back!
guhwinter.lootjes.bouwen.grens: This far! You only build on your own plot.
guhwinter.lootjes.bouwen.niet_jouw: This is someone else's build plot. Looking is fine, going in is not!
guhwinter.lootjes.bouwen.vrij: This build plot belongs to no one (yet).
guhwinter.lootjes.bouwen.dicht: You can't build now: it's open between 1 December and 5 December 18:00.
guhwinter.lootjes.bouwen.modus: Walk into your build plot in survival or adventure to get creative.
guhwinter.lootjes.bouwen.mag_niet: %s isn't allowed on your build plot (no chests, machines, redstone or spawners).
guhwinter.lootjes.bouwen.buiten_veld: You only build inside your own build plot.
guhwinter.lootjes.bouwen.item: You can't use that here: only blocks and decorating tools.
guhwinter.lootjes.bouwen.geen_kist: You can't open chests or machines on your build plot.
guhwinter.lootjes.brief.trekking.1: the Pakjesguhs shook the hat all night, and you drew the name of... %s!
guhwinter.lootjes.brief.trekking.2: Build something lovely for them on plot %s in Surprise Lane (you get creative there), and make a drawing.
guhwinter.lootjes.brief.trekking.3: You have until 5 December 18:00. And shh... it's a secret! Nyeg.
guhwinter.lootjes.brief.geen.1: this year there weren't enough names in my Big Book to draw lots. Oops!
guhwinter.lootjes.brief.geen.2: So here are %s pepernoten from me, because you were so sweet to sign up. Better luck next year, wahoog!
guhwinter.lootjes.zak.bonk: BONK BONK BONK! Someone is knocking on the door...
guhwinter.lootjes.zak.voor_de_deur: ...there's a Sinterklaas' Sack on the doorstep!
guhwinter.lootjes.zak.gekregen: Sinterklaas' Sack is in your bag: a surprise from %s! Right-click to open it.
guhwinter.lootjes.zak.tas_vol: Sinterklaas' Sack is waiting for you, but your bag is full! Free up a spot and it'll come soon.
guhwinter.lootjes.zak.leeg: Note: "Your surprise stayed empty... but it was wrapped with love!"
guhwinter.lootjes.zak.open: Everything from the sack is in your bag now. Wahoog!
guhwinter.lootjes.zak.vol: Your bag is full: the rest stays in the sack.
guhwinter.lootjes.surprise.hint: Right-click: put down  |  R or shift+scroll: turn
guhwinter.lootjes.surprise.hint_kijk: Look at the ground where your surprise should go.
guhwinter.lootjes.surprise.leeg: This present is empty: nothing to put down. You can keep it though!
guhwinter.lootjes.surprise.niet_nu: You can't do that right now.
guhwinter.lootjes.surprise.te_ver: Too far away! Come a bit closer.
guhwinter.lootjes.surprise.geplaatst: The surprise from %s is up! Shift+right-click picks it up again.
guhwinter.lootjes.surprise.fout.buiten: It doesn't fit here: too high or too low.
guhwinter.lootjes.surprise.fout.laden: The world isn't loaded here yet.
guhwinter.lootjes.surprise.fout.plein: Not on the Winter Square! Put it down at home.
guhwinter.lootjes.surprise.fout.in_de_we: Something is in the way: %s. It needs a free 7 by 7 spot.
guhwinter.lootjes.surprise.niet_van_jou: This surprise belongs to someone else: only whoever put it down can pick it up.
guhwinter.lootjes.surprise.tas_vol: Your bag is full! Free up a spot to pick up your surprise.
guhwinter.lootjes.surprise.opgepakt: The surprise from %s is back in your bag.
guhwinter.lootjes.surprise.info.eigen: Your surprise from %s. Shift+right-click picks it up.
guhwinter.lootjes.surprise.niet_slopen: You don't break a surprise! Shift+right-click picks the whole thing up.
